name: jjui
description: TUI for interacting with the Jujutsu version control system

repo.name: jjui
repo.description: jjui is a TUI designed for interacting with the Jujutsu version control system.

readme.summary: Well-structured README with GIF demos, comprehensive installation options, and good feature coverage, but configuration and troubleshooting are deferred to external docs with minimal inline detail.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section — common issues like missing jj dependency, version incompatibility, or TUI rendering problems are not addressed anywhere in the README.

injection_risks.description: The getJJRootDir function uses the exec.Command to execute a shell command with user input (location) without proper validation or sanitization.
The CreateReplacements function uses string concatenation to build custom commands and exec input, which may lead to injection risks if not properly validated.

critical_findings: High-severity injection risk in getJJRootDir function
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential injection risks and error exposure, but no secrets or critical vulnerabilities were found.

common_complaints: Documentation and discoverability gaps (built-in actions, keyboard shortcuts like SHIFT-L)
UI/UX issues with preview panes hiding input during text entry
Configuration complexity for overriding certain action bindings

Maintainer responsiveness closing issues and addressing bugs
